senses.en: used to talk about the future or about intention

example.en: She has a strong will to win.

senses.en: a legal document saying who receives your property after death

example.en: He wrote his will before the operation.

senses.en: to leave property to someone in a will

example.en: She willed the house to her niece.
example.zh: 她把房子遗赠给了侄女。

senses.en: a device with moving parts that uses power to do a task

example.en: The machine stopped after the power failed.
example.zh: 断电后机器停止了运转。

senses.en: to cut, shape, or make something with a machine

example.en: The factory machines the metal parts to exact sizes.
example.zh: 这家工厂把金属零件加工到精确尺寸。

senses.en: a powerful organization or group that controls an activity
senses.zh: 强大的组织或集团；政治机器

example.en: The party machine controlled local appointments.
example.zh: 该政党组织把控着地方任命。

example.en: My mom makes soup on Sundays.
